name: FEVER
description: Fact verification dataset of about 185k claims, annotated with evidence from Wikipedia. VitaminC provides contrastive revisions to claims as a related benchmark. No data is vendored here.
citation: FEVER: a large-scale dataset for Fact Extraction and VERification. Thorne et al., NAACL 2018.
